notes: The official guides below take effect with the first departures on 2026-10-24. DSAT's live stop endpoint and MO Transport still served the previous routes when checked on 2026-10-23.

The guides publish base stop codes. Unchanged MT2 platforms retain their previous suffixes; added platforms use the existing 36 assignments. New 6A/6B hospital stops use the other route's existing platform assignments. These suffixes are carried forward, not independently confirmed by a future-dated DSAT platform list.
Published frequency bands are retained in routes.json. The simulation's frequency field remains one representative interval per route, using the existing rounded mean of the bands.
6B does not operate on Sundays or mandatory holidays. Its weekday/Saturday service also covers public holidays that are not mandatory holidays.
